newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa golds fall with bullion, industrials lose.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa golds fall with bullion, industrials lose.

text.p: 1240 GMT - South African industrial shares shed more of morning's gains as cautious mood grabs market ahead of Wall Street open. Dealers say market still uncertain whether overnight rally in U.S. stocks sustainable. Buyers still present but recovery seen slow as nothing offered to feed on. Golds sink as bullion falls through $340 an ounce level.
* Golds lose 18.9 points to 1,251.5, industrials add 2.4 to 8,239.9 and all-shares off 9.4 at 6,987.9.
* Iscor loses 10 cents to 320 cents, Gencor off 35 cents at 18.65 rand.
